This run measured 81.3 MB/s bytes/s on "bytes per second sent by a newly busy program"; the cut is at 3.64 MB/s. The fault that comes closest to breaking this cut is svc_mem_cap on trainticket at 3.64 MB/s. This number alone separates all 272 runs.
